title: Sync intake - created share indicates per-chunk conversations

model.queryText: resource.type="cloud_run_revision" AND resource.labels.service_name="backend-sync-backfill" AND (textPayload:"omi_sync_intake outcome=created" OR jsonPayload.message:"omi_sync_intake outcome=created")

resource.type="cloud_run_revision" AND (resource.labels.service_name="backend-sync" OR resource.labels.service_name="backend-sync-backfill") AND (textPayload:"omi_sync_intake outcome=merged" OR jsonPayload.message:"omi_sync_intake outcome=merged")

annotations.summary: Sync intake is creating a conversation for more than 80% of chunks with at least 100 creates in 30m
annotations.threshold: created / (created+merged) > 0.80 with >= 100 created log lines in 30m, for 10m
annotations.user_impact: Users see one conversation per synced audio chunk instead of a continuous recording. This is the 2026-09-19 fragmentation symptom (107 shards / 121 conversations for one account), regardless of whether live STT or assignment logic caused it.
annotations.scope: Cloud Run backend-sync-backfill (created+merged) and backend-sync (merged only) ingest_sync_conversation outcomes. Prometheus scrape of this counter is not yet ingested.
annotations.verification: Cloud Logging counts of omi_sync_intake on the emitting services, not Grafana evaluation of the previous backend-sync-only filter. Measured 2026-09-21 00:00-18:00Z: created=9626 all from backend-sync-backfill (backend-sync created=0); merged=21482 backfill + 757 backend-sync. Fleet created share=9626/(9626+22239)=0.302. Expected values from the 2026-09-19 incident: one account received 121 conversations / 107 shards in a day, so created share approached 1.0 for that user's 60s sync chunks. A healthy continuous recording of N 60s chunks is 1 created + (N-1) merged = 1/N. Threshold 0.80 with >= 100 created in 30m sits above the measured 0.302 floor. Prometheus evaluation is owed after backend-sync and backend-sync-backfill are added to the Cloud Run metrics exporter.
annotations.safe_next_action: Confirm created vs merged on Cloud Logging for backend-sync-backfill and backend-sync omi_sync_intake. Do not change assignment logic here; the continuity fix is a separate PR. This alert only makes the condition visible.
annotations.evaluated_bad: 2026-09-19 per-chunk storm: created share approached 1.0 (107 shards / 121 conversations for one account). The previous backend-sync-only filter evaluated to 0 created on 2026-09-21 00:00-18:00Z while backend-sync-backfill emitted 9626 created.
annotations.evaluated_good: 2026-09-21 00:00-18:00Z fleet created share 9626/(9626+22239)=0.302 (created all from backend-sync-backfill; merged 21482 backfill + 757 backend-sync). A continuous N-chunk recording is 1/N. Threshold 0.80 sits above this measured floor.

annotations.summary: A sync job failure reason (outcome) on one sync service is more than 3x its 7-day share of jobs, with at least 50 such jobs in the last 60m
annotations.threshold: per (service, outcome != success|expected_silence): 60m share of jobs > 3x the 7-day share (the 7 days before the window), with >= 50 jobs of that outcome in 60m, AND the service's total failure share in 60m > 1.5x its baseline, for 15m. Total-failure baseline = the lower of the rolling 7 days before the window and backfill's pinned pre-regression share 0.64% (the 7 days ending 2026-10-16T16:00Z, as a constant so evaluation stays under the 30s limit); the pin keeps backfill's post-#22977 leftover visible until the backfill assignment_conflict fix lands, then is removed. A reason or service with no baseline counts as new (floor 0.01%). The guard means a relabel or split of failures between reasons (no rise in total failures) does not page.
annotations.user_impact: Uploaded recordings on that service are failing to finalize at a new, higher rate; users see missing or late conversations from offline sync.
annotations.scope: omi_sync_transcription_job_total from Managed Prometheus (datasource gmp-cloud-run, job omi-cloud-run-application-metrics; the in-cluster Prometheus could not scan 7 days of raw samples within the 30s evaluation limit), namespaces backend-sync and backend-sync-backfill (backend-integration emits no omi_sync_transcription_job_total series and is out of scope until it does), keyed by the outcome label so new reasons (the sync-fresh-fix split of upstream_error) are covered automatically. The counter records terminal attempt outcomes, not finalized jobs, so it is compared only with its own baseline; the finalized-job count is event=sync_transcription_job_finalized in Cloud Logging.
annotations.verification: Backtest 2026-10-14..10-21 (15m steps, prod Prometheus via the Grafana proxy). Without the total-failure guard: 24 sustained episodes, including backend-sync internal_error at 09:00Z right after #22977 split internal failures out of upstream_error (a relabel: backend-sync total failures fell 7.35% -> 1.19%). With the guard: 22 episodes; every 10-16..10-21 regression episode is kept, backend-sync internal_error is dropped, and backfill internal_error (total 4.76% vs pinned 0.64%) still fires. Rolling-only baseline would have hidden backfill after 60m (23 episodes). Re-run on Managed Prometheus after moving off the in-cluster Prometheus (2026-10-21 11Z, which timed out at 30s): 25 episodes, same shape (10-16..10-21 regression kept; backend-sync internal_error quiet; backfill internal_error fires). Instant evaluation 4.6s.
annotations.safe_next_action: Run the two-lane sentinel scripts/sync_failure_reasons.sh for the failure_phase / failure_class split of finalized jobs, then check the sync_finalize_exception and sync_persistence_exception site fields before changing lanes or flags.

title: Sync jobs - a sync service is failing more than 8% of jobs

annotations.summary: A sync service is failing more than 8% of sync job attempts over 60m, regardless of its baseline
annotations.threshold: per service: (attempts with outcome != success|expected_silence) / all attempts over 60m > 8%, with >= 200 attempts in 60m, for 30m. Absolute ceiling: it does not move with the 7-day baseline, so a regression that has become the baseline still warns.
annotations.user_impact: More than 1 in 12 sync attempts on that service fail; offline recordings finalize late or not at all.
annotations.scope: omi_sync_transcription_job_total via the cloud-run-application-metrics bridge, namespaces backend-sync and backend-sync-backfill (backend-integration emits no series). Counts terminal attempt outcomes, not finalized jobs. Pairs with omi-sync-failure-reason-step, which catches relative steps per reason; this rule catches a level that stays high.
annotations.verification: 2026-10-21 (Grafana proxy, attempt counter): backfill total failure share 0.58-0.87% before 10-16, 7.1% over 10-17..10-20, 8.92% in the 6h to 08:25Z, 4.76% after #22977; backend-sync 3.6% (10-17..20), 7.35% (6h to 08:25Z), 1.19% after #22977. Set at 8% with the two-lane lead while backfill internal_error (assignment_conflict) is silenced as known and owned by the backfill-conflict lane: a rise past 8% still warns. Backtest 10-14..10-21 (15m steps): 10 sustained episodes, all in the 10-17..10-21 regression (backfill 9x, backend-sync 1x), none after #22977.
annotations.safe_next_action: Run the two-lane sentinel scripts/sync_failure_reasons.sh for the failure_phase / failure_class split of finalized jobs, then check the sync_finalize_exception and sync_persistence_exception site fields before changing lanes or flags.

title: Sync STT - provider out of credits/budget (top up)

annotations.summary: Sync/prerecorded transcription jobs are failing because an STT vendor says the account is out of credits or budget
annotations.user_impact: Offline sync, prerecorded and voice-message transcription fail for everyone routed to that vendor until the account is topped up; live sessions may also lose the vendor as a fallback.
annotations.scope: gmp-cloud-run omi_sync_transcription_job_total{outcome=provider_budget_exhausted} on backend-sync and backend-sync-backfill. The outcome comes from #23234 (Modulate 402, or 429 'Insufficient credits'). Sibling of omi-stt-provider-budget (live). Silent until #23234 is deployed to Cloud Run.
annotations.verification: No history: the outcome value is new in #23234. The 2026-10-22 02:00Z Modulate credits outage produced ~200 upstream_error jobs per 30m that would have carried this outcome; at >= 3 per 15m it would have paged within ~20m instead of the ~60m the generic sync failure-rate rules took.
annotations.evaluated_bad: Modulate 429 'Insufficient credits' 2026-10-22 from ~02:00Z (classified as upstream_error at the time)
annotations.safe_next_action: Top up the named vendor account (owner: David). Do not rotate keys. Check the live page omi-stt-provider-budget for the same vendor and the kind=account circuit.
